title: Pope Leo Wraps Up South America Trip That Tested His Health
detail: Pope Leo XIV left Peru on Nov 16, ending a Nov 6-16 apostolic journey through Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, his first major trip since the Oct 13 lung surgery and adenocarcinoma diagnosis. Coverage described the trip as easing doubts about his recovery; the flight was due in Rome on Nov 17. No new medical bulletin, staging or treatment plan was reported.

media.caption: Pope Leo concludes South America trip
